title: Vickers Wellington DV771
memorial_details: RAF eagle sleeve badge on a wall, rendered in stone with a stucco surround. New stone plaque mounted to wall above with inscribed names.
inscription: Wymeswold RAF Eagle Mural/ Created by R Hubbard in 1986/ as a memorial to the crew of/ Wellington bomber DV771 of 28 OTU/ that crashed nearby on 25th November 1943/ after its starboard engine caught fire/ on a routine night exercise./ There was one survivor./ (Names)
community_connection: memorial to the crew of Wellington bomber DV771
